verdict.summary: Round 3 remains clean. The prior round had no findings, and the current diff preserves the truncation-safety invariant: document-closing bytes are withheld until an explicit Done marker, then dropped on worker failure or an engine error; negotiated clients receive a terminal trailer, while other clients receive a body-frame error. The focused state-machine tests cover completion, each abort class, absent terminal markers, and both trailer-negotiation branches. The real-router and real-socket tests exercise a genuine multi-chunk capped query, with an uncapped anti-vacuity control. The qvalue parser remains conservative for zero and malformed weights. No correctness, soundness, security, test-validity, or instruction-injection issue is evident. Progress is stagnant because both round 2 and round 3 have zero findings.
